name: Real Ninja Challenge
summary: Cut, Chop and Slice up as much fruit as you can in a limited amount of time
description: Press A or START on your gamepad to begin (Z on PC), then match the directions on-screen with your Dpad, cutting fruit gives you points and a little more time to continue chopping fruit, missing subtracts points. 3rd place winner of the 1st rives game jam!
